ImageDescription.value: Illustration from an ancient Greek vase depicting Aedon (spelled here as AEDONAI, with an additional alpha missing) killing her own son Itys on his bed.

Credit.value: Illustration from Greek Vase Paintings by JE Harrison and DS MacColl (T Fisher Unwin, 1894).
